notes: The programme pages do not state a dated application deadline for international/non-EU applicants, so no intake is listed. Only general application periods are given: 'For the summer semester: 1 November 2026 - 30 November 2026' and 'Applications for degree programmes with open admission are generally accepted from ... 01 December to 01 March (summer semester)'. The tuition quotes give 1,000 EUR per semester for non-EU and for international students, consistent across both pages. The bachelor's programme is listed as open-admission (zulassungsfreie Studiengänge) with the summer-semester application window 1 December to 1 March.

evidence.quote: As measured by the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, you need level B2, as proven by – an IELTS (International English Language Testing System) score of 6.0 or better or – a TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) score of 84 points or better
English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT (since 2026): 4 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 84 IELTS Academic: 6

note.fr: Vous devez avoir l'équivalent d'un certificat d'accès à l'université allemand et réussir un examen d'entrée académique.
note.en: You must have the equivalent of a German university entrance certificate and pass an academic entrance exam.
